entities._comment: stays within the ≤8/map light budget (the only light this map ships).
entities.observe: A mossy, sagging roof, a crooked chimney, and one window that's always lit no matter the hour.
entities.toast: The door's shut. Whatever's inside isn't asking for company right now.

entities.observe: A stone taller than it should be able to stand on its own, glowing faint purple at the seams.
Another of the ring-stones, humming faintly if you hold still.
Another of the ring-stones, humming faintly if you hold still.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The pot waits for something cooked plain and honest.
entities.locked_toast: Something's meant to go in this, cooked properly. You don't know your way around a stew pot. Yet.

on_skill_use.toast: [Basic Cooking] — You cook the offering plain and honest, the way you'd feed anyone who'd walked far to eat.

entities.observe: An iron pot set by the cottage door, empty and waiting. Someone means for it to be used.

entities.item_hint_toast: The kettle wants yarrow before it gives anything back.
entities.skill_hint_toast: The cauldron's lit and the water's talking to itself. Hands that mean it could bring a remedy out of that.
entities.locked_toast: A witch's cauldron, warm and waiting. Whatever it wants from you, it isn't just stirring.

on_skill_use.toast: [Hedge Remedy] — You stir like you're sorry for the sick, the way she said. What comes off the ladle is the color of meaning it.

entities._comment: v0.16.1 #6 ECONOMY: the brew arm is INGREDIENT-GATED (requires_item + on_skill_use.remove_item, the #155 bench seam). Bounds the brew->sell arbitrage by yarrow on hand; CONSUMING also arms wi_game.gd's dup-output refusal (returns BEFORE record_accomplishment), so pack-spam banks no free witch_craft_used toward [Witch]. Coverage: qa/scripts/witch_brew_loop.json.
Light budget: witch_hollow carries 1 base light (witch_cottage_prop) before this, well under the 8/map cap.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Cold candle-stubs either side of the door. No match will do it.
entities.locked_toast: A row of cold candle-stubs, set either side of the door. Whatever lights them, it isn't a match.

on_skill_use.toast: [Light] — The candles catch, one after another, without a flame ever touching them.

entities.observe: Cold wax and old wicks, set along the threshold like they're waiting for something specific.

entities._comment: reuses the registered `hollow_mushroom_cluster` sprite (previously decor-only) as a distinct interactive tangle, visually apart from the standing stones themselves.
entities.skill_hint_toast: The knot is too deliberate for briar. It wants a closer look than eyes give for free.
entities.locked_toast: Roots and briar, knotted tighter than any plant ties itself. Whatever it's holding, an untrained eye won't find it.

on_skill_use.toast: [Observe] — The knot isn't wood at all, once you look right at it: a price, tied off and waiting to be paid. You pay it yourself, plainly, and the tension goes out of the air like a held breath let go.

entities.observe: A snarl of root and briar at the center of the standing stones, tied in a knot that doesn't look like it grew that way.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The stone sits where the ground feels heaviest. That's not an accident.
entities.locked_toast: A standing stone, older than the village and not saying anything about it.

on_skill_use.toast: [Detect Magic] — Light runs under the turf in one long seam, straight through the stone and away west. The hollow is built on a current.

talk_pool: Sit. The tea is nearly right, and nothing sensible was ever decided standing up.
Kindness asks questions, dear. That is my craft, so forgive me for asking several.
The village worries loudly. I prefer to worry with a pot on.
entities.observe: A small grey witch in a hat pressed with tea leaves and old flowers. She holds a cup like the answer to a question you haven't asked yet.

lines: The fields breathe easier. So do I. Tea?
You did the hollow a kindness. It remembers, and so do I.
So you found the old hut. Somebody drew that boundary long before me, and drew it kindly.
A ward that asks is worth ten that shout. Mine ask. Sit, and I'll tell you why.

dialogue.speaker: Eloise
dialogue.text: Tea's still hot. The offer doesn't get warmer with asking twice.

entities._comment_visual_states: Visual states are order-sensitive: later satisfied entries override; dusk swaps sprite, while night also applies the legibility tint.

entities._comment: R6 (#95) trap placement: a briar-snare east of briar_collectors' nest (9,6).
entities.once_per_waking_toast: The briar holds nothing new today.
entities.skill_hint_toast: Brambles knotted into a tight loop, low against the undergrowth. Nothing grows that way on its own.
entities.locked_toast: The brambles here twist into a tight loop, low to the ground. It doesn't look natural. You can't tell how to clear it without setting it off.

on_skill_use.toast: You work the knot loose one bramble at a time, careful of the thorns. Snagged in the weave: a coin, tarnished green from the damp.

entities._comment: v0.16 #305 ruling 3: a NEW door, leaving witch_cottage_prop [3,7] and witch_cottage_reachability.json byte-untouched (that canonical pins the cottage's single approach [3,8] and its toast twice). [1,7]'s only free cardinal neighbour is [1,8]. sprite `door`, NOT witch_cottage: that art is 5x5 cells and would redraw the cottage two cells away. No `light`: the cottage prop is this map's only one. Tint = sunlit timber, deliberate: hollow-green here vanished against the treeline.
entities.observe: A second, smaller house at the hollow's west edge, its roof half fallen in. The lintel is cut with a line of shallow marks, worn nearly smooth, and the door stands open on the dark.
Bracken pressed flat in a hollow under the northern trees, and the smell of something that has been eating well.
entities.gate_closed_toast: The bracken is pressed flat and the smell of it is old. Nothing about this is your business until somebody tells you otherwise.
